description: Work with your Recruit CRM data directly from ChatGPT. Search, analyze, create, and update candidates, jobs, companies, contacts, tasks, meetings, notes, call logs, hotlists, hiring stages, pitch activity, and custom fields. Prepare client briefs, analyze job pipelines, assign candidates to jobs, update hiring stages, log recruiting activity, create follow-up tasks, and review account details before meetings. Use it for quick CRM updates or deeper recruiting workflow management, with answers and actions based on the records in your Recruit CRM account.
